title: I Won't Let You Have It!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe! It's honey bread day! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's the last one! Lucky me! I'd better grab it before—
Phew, thank goodness I made it before they sold ou—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Teio, were you going for that honey bread too?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: (Oh no. Knowing Spe, I bet she'll be like…)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I won't let you have it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I challenge you to a duel for this honey bread!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: (Or something like that…)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: How about we split it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I accept your challenge! Okay, whoever wins gets the bread!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: You two are racing?! I wanna run too! I'm gonna run and win that bread!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah… No, we're not racing or anything. I just jumped to conclusions and—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hehehe… Sounds like you're just chickening out because you're afraid of losing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I-I never said that! Quit putting words in my mouth!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ooh! A race for the honey bread sounds like a great idea! Well, you'd better kiss that bread goodbye because…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I won't let you have it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Grrr!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That honey bread is mine!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Aww, I lost! But that was really fun! It kind of felt like a field day for a second there!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huff… Wheeze! Huff… puff… I'm… so tired…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ahaha… Same. I'm hungrier than before, too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe… Let's all share the bread, then! That was the original plan anyway.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Plus, honey bread tastes best after exercising! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the three of them split the honey bread equally among themselves.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I won fair and square, Teio, so the bread's all mine!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Urrrgh! I can't believe I lost!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmph! I'm going to go train! I won't lose to you next time!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huff… Wheeze! Huff… puff… Wh-what's that? Y-you wanna… go another lap?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Come at me… Wheeze! I'll take you on… any day!
